cause: CameraService.Check returns Gate.Dialog when CNWCModule.DialogCamera is set, which stops first-person eye placement during NPC conversation.
evidence: User NPC screenshots and cx.log [camera] gate: dialog camera while mode 2; M4 install SWITCHED_AND_VERIFIED
changes: Ignore only ordinary DialogCamera gate when verified first-person Driving camera is active; do not bypass cutscene, attachment, lock or other camera modes.
Hold the pre-dialog yaw/pitch during NPC conversation and suppress engine dialogue turn impulses; restore that orientation on exit.
Keep player-eye placement and first-person head/body filtering active during NPC conversation.
Independently gate Action Camera's mouse capture off while a native NPC dialog is active so cursor and replies remain clickable.
